title: AI-evaluation market-universe gap map
what_this_is: A measured directory of the public AI-evaluation universe, with what CSOAI has actually MEASURED alongside it. Repository stars are a popularity signal, not a capability measurement. Upstream listings are INDEXED, not measured by us.
what_this_does_not_establish: That any competitor is good or bad, or that CSOAI is better than any of them. That the task counts are complete: a task that is not vendored in a repository is not counted, and a repository that is private is invisible here. That any star count says anything about measurement quality.
counting_rule: Every count here is measured from the repository at its default branch, with the SHA-256 of the API response recorded beside it. Most are TREE counts of task and scenario definitions. One — the LongFact prompt set — is an OBJECT count read from the file bytes of the same pinned branch, because a file count would answer a different question than a prompt count. A count that could not be read is null, never 0.

candidate_readers.csoai_gap: HELM carries 290 scenario definition modules; CSOAI's board declares 33 axis slots, of which 23 carry a run. The units differ — one frozen bank per axis against 290 scenario modules — so the numbers are not a scoreboard. The difference is depth per axis, not slot count.

readers_not_located.finding: The org's public repositories were listed. The two candidates that look like evaluation suites are not: epoch-research/ftm (25 stars) describes itself as 'Work in progress! I don't recommend looking at the code right now.', and epoch-research/SWE-bench (20 stars) is a 'Docker image registry for SWE-bench'. No published, countable evaluation suite was found.

Both the organisation and the user endpoints answered HTTP 404. The arena's code on GitHub is lm-sys/FastChat, which is listed above. The absence of a separate organisation is a measurement, not a zero.

csoai_gaps.gap: The whole subject axis family is declared and unmeasured: lab practice, company practice, measurer integrity, harness fidelity, interop conformance, humanoid deployment, regulator transparency, interpretability/reproducibility, claim maintenance and serving fidelity.
csoai_gaps.note: The subject axes (2026-10-16): each applies to ONE subject type (applies_to). Declared slots, UNMEASURED until a frozen sha-pinned bank with n_valid >= 30 passes the gate. Census checks are a DISCOVERED check grid, never scores here. No aggregate score and no overall rank.

csoai_gaps.gap: No model-comparison axis separates a leader, so the board states TIE and UNTESTED rather than a ranking.
Most deterministic-fact run artifacts are content-addressed but unsigned, so the evidence chain for those axes rests on identity of bytes, not on a signer.

Three measured axes carry no public leader, because the named leader holds no signed per-model card in the public card index. The axis stays MEASURED; the unverifiable leader claim is dropped rather than invented.

Our own specialist models are excluded from public leader attribution on eight axes, so the public board reports external leaders only. This is a governance rule, not a measurement gap, and it is stated rather than hidden.

The board's scale is declared slots, not a published catalogue of task definitions. Readers here that publish task directories are not comparable to us by count; the comparison is in what is published, not how many rows there are.

totals.separation_public_count: 0 of 14 model-comparison axes separated a leader · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED
totals.separation_public_count_note: Read with public_count, never instead of it. measured_axes counts axes with a RUN behind them; it is not a count of axes with a separated result. SEPARATED, TIE and UNTESTED are three states and none is folded into another. Derived from the axis array, never typed. The same three numbers appear below as separated_leads / ties / untested_separations and in limitations[0]; there is one derivation.
totals.model_fleets_note: Counts model-comparison AXES (one fleet per axis), not models. The number of distinct models measured is a different quantity, derived from the signed cards: /interop/models-measured.json (list at /models-measured/).
totals.count_grammar: 33 axes are on the board; 23 of them carry a measurement and 10 are declared slots with no run behind them. The larger number counts slots, the smaller counts measurements — quote both or quote the smaller. A published slot exists so the gap is visible; it is not evidence of anything having been measured. A measurement is not a separated leader either: 0 of 14 model-comparison axes separated a leader · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED.

gspc.note: The 14 behavioural axes: a model fleet answers a frozen bank, graded deterministically. Plus effect-binding (ADR-002), a deterministic-facts probe of tool-call SERVERS, not a fleet: n counts servers probed, it has no leader, no accuracy and no separation, and it joins no mean.

subject.note: The subject axes (2026-10-16): each applies to ONE subject type (applies_to). Declared slots, UNMEASURED until a frozen sha-pinned bank with n_valid >= 30 passes the gate. Census checks are a DISCOVERED check grid, never scores here. No aggregate score and no overall rank.

financial.note: The 8 financial/domain axes (ADR-001), all MEASURED as deterministic-facts runs — issuer-account flags read off the public ledger (financial n=16 on the live XRPL reader; provenance-controls n=6) and public statistical series, graded by rule with no model, no fleet and no judgement. None of the eight is a model comparison, so none has a leader, an accuracy or a separation determination, and none contributes to any mean below — measured is not the same as scored. The two former index slots are measured as component facts (ai-adoption-components, labour-components), never restored to the retired MEASURED-INDEX-v0.1 sticker (C-2026-0826-05). as_of is the producer run (scripts/grade_financial_ledgers.py), never a typed 2026-08-25.

totals.sweep_note: Swept 2026-08-26 under ADR-001. The 8 financial/domain axes were ruled in on 2026-08-24 but were absent from this payload until the sweep, so this endpoint reported 14 — the un-swept state. All 8 now carry published deterministic-facts run artifacts. Today 23 of 33 axes on the board carry a run behind them: 14 model-comparison and 9 deterministic-fact axes. The fact axes carry no accuracy and no leader — measured is not the same as scored. 2 run artifacts carry an Ed25519 signature; 7 are content-addressed but unsigned. No signature is inferred from a content_id.

financial_run_attestations.note: Derived from each deterministic-facts axis's run_attestation field, in BOTH families since 2026-09-22 (effect-binding is a gspc-family fact run). A content_id proves identity of bytes, not signer authorization.

totals.license_note: Board data is CC-BY-4.0 (attribute: Council of AI, CSOAI Ltd 16939677, councilof.ai). Our own valve-2 bench-card flagged the payload's missing licence field — fixed same day.
totals.items_note: items sums each axis's n. Financial-axis n values count issuer accounts, public series, or frozen vendor URLs as declared on each row — not bank items. Unmeasured slots contribute 0 because nothing was measured. Read items as 'rows behind the board', not as a single comparable sample.
totals.separation_scope_note: Separation asks whether a leader's lead over a fleet is statistically real, so it applies only to the model-comparison axes. The financial axes have no fleet and no leader: they are not counted as untested, because no separation test is applicable to them.
totals.lid: 23 axes measured · 14 model comparisons: 0 separated · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED · 9 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate.
totals.own_model_exclusion_note: Own council-specialist models were removed from the public per-axis leaders on 8 of the 14 model-comparison axes (governance, provenance, continuity, conformance, openness, care, art5-safeguard, affect); 9 axes carry an external public leader. A neutral measurement body does not compare its own models against the vendors it measures. This changes leader attribution and the separation/mean tallies (which are over externally-led axes only), NOT measured_axes: every axis still carries a measurement, so the measured count is unchanged. The excluded models' signed cards are untouched — measurement happened; it is simply not published as a public comparison of our own model. The excluded models are system-prompt overlays on stock base models, not trained weights (C-2026-0930-11).
totals.uncarded_leader_note: The public per-axis leader was removed on 3 of the 14 model-comparison axes (machinery-conformity, cross-reality, detector-interop) whose named leader was an external model carrying NO signed per-model card in the public card index (/signed/card_index.json). The board's promise is that every named leader links to the Ed25519 card behind it; where no such card exists, no leader or accuracy is asserted rather than invented. Each of these axes stays MEASURED — the fleet aggregate (fleet_mean) is a real measurement — so measured_axes is unchanged; only the unverifiable leader claim is dropped. public_leader_state=NO_SIGNED_CARD on each. This changes leader attribution and the separation/mean tallies (over carded, externally-led axes only), NOT the measured count.
totals.mean_note: Means are over MEASURED MODEL-COMPARISON axes that carry the field. mean_accuracy averages the per-axis LEADERS; mean_fleet_mean averages each axis's measured fleet — the difference is selection, not skill. mean_harm is the severity-weighted failure mass the mean accuracy hides; it exists only for the measured board-v2 axes. No financial axis enters any of these means: an axis with no accuracy contributes nothing rather than a zero.

current_csoai_coverage.note: Quoted from the live board by field name. The board declares 33 axis slots; 23 are MEASURED, 10 are declared with no run behind them. An unmeasured axis is a visible gap, not a zero, and never a fail.
